task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, then place a $2500.50 buy order. After that, get the latest AAPL quote and send that snapshot to me in the app with high priority, then check the status of my living room light, get its current light snapshot, and set it to 75% brightness. Next, get the current time in New York, check the weather in New York, and then create a snapshot of my trading workspace and alert me in the app with high priority.

user_input.query: Please check whether NASDAQ is open for me, and if it is, place a buy order for 2500.5 USD of AAPL for user trader_01. After that, get the latest AAPL quote and send that snapshot to me in the app on channel app with high priority. Then check the status of my living room light with device ID light_living, grab its current light snapshot, and set it to 75% brightness. Next, get the current time in New York using America/New_York, and check the weather in New York. Finally, create a snapshot of my trading workspace at /srv/trading-workspace, save it as post_trade_snapshot, and alert me in the app with high priority.
